buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Provisions for workmen compensation, insurance, public liability, property damage, insurance etc. to be ensured by the contractor. Also, safety measures prescribed for working in Extra High Voltage & use of personnel protective equipment must be adhered to. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of The Registrar, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi, Lothian Road, Kashmere Gate payable at Delhi . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of The Registrar A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms and Conditions for Allotment and Operation of Photocopy/Xerox Facilities at University Campuses 1. Purpose of Facility: The photocopy/Xerox facilities shall primarily cater to the requirements of student s, visitors, faculty members, officers, employees, and various academic and administrative offices/Division s of the University.

2. Operational Timings: The photocopy/Xerox facilities shall remain operational from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM on all working days (Monday to Saturday). However, the services shall be required to extend the operational hours, whenever necessary, as per the directions of the Competent Authority of the University. 3. Space to be Allotted: The approximate area proposed to be allotted for providing photocopy/Xerox fa cilities at the respective campuses of the University shall be as under: a. Kashmere Gate Campus: 5.85 sqm (approximately). b. Lodhi Road Campus: 12.25 sqm (approximately). The exact location and area of the space shall be as identified and allotted by the University. 4. Licence Fee and Electricity Charges: a. The Licensee shall be required to pay licence fee @ ₹940/- per sqm. per month, separately for the s pace allotted at Kashmere Gate Campus and Lodhi Road Campus. b. Electricity charges shall be payable separately on an actual consumption basis, as assessed by the Univ ersity or the concerned authority. c. The licence fee and other applicable charges shall be payable within the prescribed timelines and in acc ordance with the terms and conditions of the allotment. 5. Provision of Services to University Offices: a. The Licensee shall provide photocopying/Xerox services to all academic and administrative offices, Scho ols, Centres, Divisions and other establishments of the University, as and when required. b. Such services shall be provided on a requisition basis, subject to the requirements of the concerned office and the approval of the Competent Authority, wherever applicable. c. Payment for services availed by the University offices shall be made on a quarterly basis, on submission of duly verified bills/invoices by the Licensee and after obtaining the requisite approval of the Competent A uthority. d. The Licensee shall maintain proper records of all photocopying/Xerox services provided to the Universit y offices and submit supporting details along with the bills for verification and payment. .
